blockers.description: MACE has no exact v0.3.16 documentation corpus and its docs branch has a different revision and restrictive license.
NequIP exact rendered v0.19.0 docs are unavailable and autodoc bodies remain external.
FairChem v1 generated AutoAPI/missing page and unresolved legacy checkpoint rights prevent complete coverage.
FairChem v2 rolling drift and excluded non-text assets prevent complete rendered coverage.
UMA model-card, reference YAML, checkpoint byte identities, and custom terms remain gated or unresolved.
External FairChem dataset archive identities and reference-DFT software, potential, raw-output, and gated-storage rights remain unresolved.

declared_scope.statement: The exact OC20 page states CC-BY-4.0 dataset terms and VASP 5.4 RPBE reference calculations; this is not a license for VASP, PAW/POTCAR contents, or raw outputs.
The exact OC22 page states CC-BY-4.0 dataset terms and VASP 5.4 PBE+U reference calculations; software, pseudopotential and raw-output rights remain separate.
The exact OC25 page states CC-BY-4.0 dataset terms and VASP 6.4 RPBE+D3 reference calculations; external access and artifact rights remain independently gated.
The exact ODAC23 page states CC-BY-4.0 dataset terms and VASP 5.4 PBE+D3 reference calculations; gated storage and reference artifacts remain separate.
The exact OMat24 page states CC-BY-4.0 dataset terms and VASP 5.4 PBE/PBE+U reference calculations; pseudopotential and raw-output rights are not inherited.
The exact OMC25 page states CC-BY-4.0 dataset terms and VASP PBE+D3 reference calculations; VASP and PAW/POTCAR rights remain separate.
The exact OMol25 page states CC-BY-4.0 dataset terms and ORCA 6 reference calculations using wB97M-V/def2-TZVPD; this does not grant ORCA software or raw-output redistribution rights.
FairChem framework source, UMA model artifacts, dataset distributions, and reference-DFT software/pseudopotential/raw-output materials require four independent identity and rights records.
Dataset documentation may describe a DFT protocol but cannot grant VASP/ORCA software, PAW/POTCAR or other potential contents, private raw outputs, or gated Argonne/Globus storage access.
Generated API pages depend on the exact source tree; this metadata-only catalog records the tree identity but not generated page bodies.
Database and pickle assets present under docs are inventory metadata only and are never retrieved, opened, or deserialized.
The source table of contents contains generated AutoAPI references, one missing page, and commented/excluded pages; source-tree identity alone cannot claim complete rendered coverage.
The exact v1 docs tree contains 60 paths, including 47 Markdown pages and binary assets.
The reviewed repository source is MIT; this does not establish any legacy pretrained checkpoint license.
FairChem v1 is pinned to tag fairchem_core-1.10.0, commit 977a80328f2be44649b414a9907a1d6ef2f81e95.
FairChem v1 APIs and pretrained artifacts are not interchangeable with the breaking v2 rewrite.
Legacy model pages identify datasets and checkpoints but do not provide sufficient artifact-specific weight-license evidence; weights remain excluded and unresolved.
Notebook, trajectory, pickle, CIF, XYZ and image assets are recorded only at tree-inventory level and are never executed, deserialized, or treated as documentation text.
The exact docs tree contains 95 paths and 66 Markdown source pages; the MyST table of contents selects 64 pages.
oc20_slabs.md and benchmark.md are source pages outside the 64-page MyST table of contents and must not disappear from source-tree coverage.
The reviewed repository source is MIT; the UMA model repository, pretrained weights, datasets and reference-DFT artifacts have separate rights records.
FairChem v2 is pinned to tag fairchem_core-2.21.0, commit f47a0a6f0f594ea051b70091304864242df933e1.
The rolling main documentation differs from exact tag 2.21.0 and cannot substitute without an explicit drift review.
The exact source-tree identity is retained for API-reference closure, but source bodies and embedded tensor assets remain external.
FairChem v2 is a breaking rewrite and does not accept v1 APIs or pretrained artifacts as interchangeable evidence.
The source used by the rolling ReadTheDocs build is pinned here to docs-branch commit bff7c94d8fbfdc3dde707ade12db5f36b97683b5, not to framework tag v0.3.16.
The exact docs tree contains 36 paths, including 29 RST pages and non-text assets; the tree receipt does not embed the page bodies.
The reviewed docs branch LICENSE is an Academic Software License with academic/noncommercial restrictions and is not the framework release MIT license.
The foundation-model page records different licenses across model families; a framework or docs license never establishes a selected model artifact's license.
The retrieved rolling search index enumerates 29 rendered pages at the recorded timestamp.
ANI_trained_MACE.zip is present in the docs tree but is excluded from retrieval, storage, inspection, and loading.
The docs branch identifies itself as 0.3.13 and differs from framework v0.3.16; /en/v0.3.16/ is unavailable, so rolling pages cannot be represented as exact v0.3.16 documentation.
The exact setup.cfg exposes eleven console scripts, including mace_run_train, mace_eval_configs, mace_prepare_data, and mace_create_lammps_model; none is authorized or executed here.
The exact mace/ tree is identified by git tree 8053aa0d2d4966734927336b062fd1511e6698ea, but its bodies remain external to this metadata-only pack.
Tag v0.3.16 contains no docs/ tree, so exact release source alone cannot establish complete MACE documentation coverage.
The v0.3.16 framework LICENSE is MIT and applies to that source release only; it does not license the separate docs branch, model artifacts, datasets, or reference-DFT artifacts.
The MACE framework source is pinned to tag v0.3.16, commit 4d2da09413ac1407f37cdbb6b81fa28e4c15655e; no rolling branch may substitute for it.
The machine-readable central authority and consumer-binding proposal is review-only and does not mutate or activate any central registry entry.
The Skill requires separate framework, model, dataset, and reference-DFT rights records and never infers one from another.
The source extractor is offline and neither downloads nor loads checkpoints, model packages, datasets, provider libraries, or serialized assets.
MACE framework/docs revisions, NequIP exact/rolling docs, FairChem v1/v2 APIs, UMA model repositories, and external dataset records must remain distinct identities.
The Skill remains development, non-routable, non-executing, and at claim_ceiling=no_positive_claim.
A complete rendered API requires both the exact docs tree and the exact 153-path nequip/ code tree used by autodoc; this metadata pack embeds neither.
The exact docs tree contains 77 paths, including 68 source pages: 30 Markdown and 38 RST.
The current ReadTheDocs latest build is from a different main revision and exact tag URLs are unavailable, so it cannot silently substitute for v0.19.0.
The v0.19.0 source license is MIT; checkpoints, packaged models and training data require separate identities and license evidence.
NequIP is pinned to tag v0.19.0, commit ea3ac14154338da83386be75d619b0cd964ffb42.
The raw gated model card was unavailable without accepted access terms, so task/domain/license claims remain incomplete.
The public repository metadata reports license:other and gated FAIR Chemistry License v1 plus Acceptable Use Policy terms; the FairChem framework MIT license does not apply to UMA weights.
Public metadata enumerates uma-m-1p1.pt, uma-s-1.pt, uma-s-1p1.pt, uma-s-1p2.pt and uma-s-1p2p1.pt as names only; no artifact bytes are included.
Gated reference YAML files are not retrieved; provider defaults, heads, element references and task settings remain unresolved.
facebook/UMA is manually gated; public metadata does not authorize access to or redistribution of gated model-card and artifact bytes.
The public API reported repository revision f611b917d9c68566bbbeccbb0aa0f7cad1696cb2 at retrieval time.
A repository revision is not a checkpoint byte SHA-256; no weight byte hash was acquired, and weights are never downloaded, opened, or loaded.
